title: Pediatric patient-room blue and green preference over white
statement:
In pediatric patient-room and related design contexts, blue and green are preferred over white by both children and design professionals, supporting calm, non-clinical primary palettes for child-facing health interfaces.

Options:
- Preferred blue: #4169E1 royal blue (fits: pediatric portal)
- Preferred green: #3CB371 medium sea green (fits: child health app)
- Least preferred: #FFFFFF pure white (fits: avoid as dominant)
- Secondary warm: #FFD700 soft yellow (fits: accent only)
appliesWhen: Applies to: health, kids. Audience: children under 10, parents.

source.title: Design Professionals' Viewpoint on Color Application in the Design of Pediatric Patients' Rooms
